responsibility: Implements conversion bridges between GCC’s REAL_VALUE_TYPE representation and MPFR numbers. It serializes real constants to hexadecimal strings for mpfr_set_str, reconstructs REAL_VALUE_TYPE values from MPFR significands and exponents with the appropriate GCC format or type, and handles NaN and infinity mapping, enabling higher-precision MPFR-based constant folding while keeping GCC’s internal real representation as the surrounding API.
same_name_distinction: Implements only the conversion bridge between GCC real values and MPFR, translating REAL_VALUE_TYPE to and from MPFR via hexadecimal/string-based conversion and NaN/Inf mapping; unlike gcc/real.cc it does not implement general real arithmetic or format semantics.
